
Package : IO {
  String code;
  Integer i;
  Integer(0, 255, 255, 0) acc;
  Integer plusOrMinus : code {
    INIT i;
    INIT acc;
    While i ^ code(length) Do {
      If !(code(i) ^ 101011) Then {
        INCR acc;
      }
      If !(code(i) ^ 101101) Then {
        charPut(acc);
        DECR acc;
      }
      INCR i;
    }
    0;
  }
} plusOrMinus;
